title: WhatsApp bot: contact card without text, replies to reactions, ignores manual staff messages, invents recipe/allergen info

timeline_local_time.event: Customer asks whether the 'arroz seco de secreto con ajetes' is made with beef stock (cow-protein intolerance)
Bot calls get_rice_menu then send_contact; ONLY a vCard is delivered, with no text at all
Staff types manually from the restaurant phone: 'Hola cualquier consulta pregunte a gerencia del restaurante a este número' (fromMe=true, stored correctly)
Customer reacts 👍 (reactionMessage). Bot replies 'Ahora mismo solo puedo gestionar mensajes de texto...'
Customer re-sends the same question (new message id 3AD17D809386E88D6118)
Bot answers 'SÍ se elabora con caldo de carne (generalmente de ternera...)' and recommends alternatives. INVENTED: get_rice_menu only returns names, with no ingredients/stock/allergens
Staff types again manually (stored). Staff also forwards a contact card manually (contactMessage fromMe=true, 22:31:57), which is NOT stored because it has no text

findings.symptom: First reply was a contact card with no text
root_cause: The LLM had no grounded answer for an ingredient/allergen question, so it followed rule 8 (human escalation) and called send_contact only; it never called send_message.

botProcessMessage (internal/api/whatsapp_bot_webhook.go) treats send_contact as a 'delivery tool' (botDeliveryTools), so botDeliveredReply() returns true and the final assistant text or fallback is never sent. A bare vCard counts as a complete reply.
The send_contact tool (whatsapp_bot_tools.go) has no 'message' parameter, and nothing makes the model explain the card. Only the same-day and extras guards pair a card with a notice text.
findings.evidence: log: 'iterations=3 tools=get_rice_menu,send_contact'; SQLite row 248 is the only assistant output for row 247

findings.symptom: Bot answered after the customer reacted to a message
root_cause: Evolution delivers reactions as messages.upsert with messageType 'reactionMessage'. evolutionGateway.ParseInboundMessage (whatsapp_gateway_evolution.go) does not inspect messageType. It returns ok=true with Text=''.
processInboundBotMessage then treats any empty-text message as 'unsupported media' and sends the fallback 'Ahora mismo solo puedo gestionar mensajes de texto...' (source unsupported_content).
The same path would also fire for protocolMessage (deletes/edits), stickers, pollUpdate, receipts etc. The UAZAPI parser has the same weakness.
findings.evidence: Evolution log: key.id 3AA270D59B90310EB6FD messageType 'reactionMessage' text '👍' at 1790281861 (22:31:01) -> SQLite row 250 at 22:31:01

findings.symptom: Bot kept answering after staff wrote manually
root_cause: Manual messages ARE registered in the session DB: rows 249 and 253 have role=assistant, source=manual_whatsapp (handleBotWebhookEvolution FromMe branch). botTouchSession also updates MySQL whatsapp_bot_sessions.last_message_at.
But nothing uses that intervention as a signal. There is no human-takeover/pause state, so the next inbound customer message (row 251) runs the full agent loop again.

In the history, manual messages are merged into the neighbouring assistant turn (normalizeBotConversationHistory concatenates same-role messages), and the prompt has no rule about staff interventions. The model sees them as its own previous text and does not defer to staff.
Manual non-text messages (the vCard staff sent at 22:31:57, images, audio) have Text='' and are dropped silently, so neither the history nor a pause trigger records them.
findings.evidence: SQLite rows 249/253 source=manual_whatsapp; the bot still answered row 251 at 22:31:31; Evolution contactMessage fromMe=true id 2A7AD4DC7BB99A82103A not in SQLite

findings.symptom: Bot answered confidently about the recipe (beef stock) with no data
root_cause: get_rice_menu (whatsapp_bot_rice_menu.go) returns only rice names, kind, supplement and advance_order. It has no ingredients, stock base or allergens. The LLM invented 'sí se elabora con caldo de carne (generalmente de ternera)' and 'Meloso de secreto ... sin ternera'.
The prompt forbids inventing availability, hours, prices and rices (rules 4 and 12), but says nothing about ingredients, recipes, allergens or intolerances. This is a food-safety risk.
The final plain-text answer was delivered via the agent_plain_text path even though rule 1 says to use send_message, so no guard ever reviews the content.

plan.title: Ignore reactions and non-conversational events at parse time
changes: Add 'messageType' (top-level field of data) plus ReactionMessage/ProtocolMessage/StickerMessage/PollUpdateMessage/EditedMessage raw fields to the Evolution inbound struct.

Add a field IsIgnorable bool to waInbound / botWebhookMessage. Set it to true for messageType in {reactionMessage, protocolMessage, pollUpdateMessage, editedMessage, senderKeyDistributionMessage, messageContextInfo-only} or when the reactionMessage raw is present.
In handleBotWebhookEvolution and handleBotWebhook, return 200 {processed:false, ignored:'reaction'} BEFORE processInboundBotMessage (no fallback, no daily-cap consumption).
Apply the same check in parseBotWebhookMessage for UAZAPI (messageType contains 'reaction' or 'protocol').
Log checkpoint: '[bot] restaurant=%d sender=%s ignored messageType=%s' (coordination id wa_bot_ignore_non_conversational_v1).
plan.acceptance: A reactionMessage payload never produces an outbound message or a conversation_messages row

plan.title: Human takeover: pause the bot for a conversation after a manual staff message
changes: Migration: ALTER TABLE whatsapp_bot_sessions ADD COLUMN bot_paused_until DATETIME(3) NULL.

In the FromMe branch (Evolution and UAZAPI): for ANY manual message (text or not) that was not sent by the backend itself, set bot_paused_until = NOW() + tenant.HumanTakeoverMinutes (default 120, configurable in whatsapp_bot_config.config_json 'human_takeover_minutes'; 0 disables).

Tell backend-originated sends apart from phone-typed ones: record outbound message ids returned by gw.SendText/SendContact/SendMenu (Evolution returns key.id) in an in-memory TTL set (reuse the botSeenBefore pattern). A FromMe webhook whose id is in the set is our own echo and must NOT pause the bot. Only unknown FromMe ids count as manual staff messages.

Record manual non-text messages too, as descriptive placeholders (e.g. '[Personal envió una tarjeta de contacto: Alqueria Villa Carmen 34638857294]', '[Personal envió una imagen]') so the history is complete.

In processInboundBotMessage, after dedup: if bot_paused_until > NOW(), record the inbound message (source 'inbound_paused'), touch the session and return {processed:true, paused:true} without running the agent or sending any fallback (unsupported_content included).
Backoffice follow-up (optional, same PR if trivial): expose pause state plus a 'Reactivar bot' action on the conversation view (data-testid='wa-bot-conversation-resume-button').
plan.acceptance: After staff types from the phone, the customer's next messages within the takeover window get no bot reply, but they are stored in SQLite

plan.title: Make staff interventions visible and authoritative in the LLM context
changes: History(): also select source. When source='manual_whatsapp', prefix the text with '[Mensaje escrito por el personal del restaurante]: ' so it is not merged anonymously into the bot's own turn.

Add a default rule: 'Si en el historial hay mensajes del personal del restaurante, respétalos: no los contradigas ni repitas información que el personal ya ha dado; si el personal ha indicado que el cliente contacte con gerencia, no respondas por tu cuenta a esa consulta.'
plan.acceptance: Prompt/history given to the model clearly labels staff messages

plan.title: A contact card must never be sent alone
changes: Add a required 'message' string to the send_contact tool schema (the explanation shown to the customer). The executor sends that text via sendWhatsAppTextTracked BEFORE the vCard (source 'agent_contact_intro').

Server-side safety net: if the model omits or empties 'message', send a default intro reusing the extras/same-day notice style: 'Soy un asistente de reservas con Inteligencia Artificial y no dispongo de esa información. Para esta consulta, contacte con el restaurante 👇' plus botFormatPhoneDisplay(phone).
Remove 'send_contact' from botDeliveryTools, or keep it but still deliver botFinalAssistantText when a turn delivered only a contact card and the final text is non-empty and was not already sent.
Update rule 8: whenever you send the contact card, explain briefly why in the same reply.
plan.acceptance: Every send_contact delivery in conversation_messages is preceded by an assistant text row in the same turn

plan.title: Stop inventing ingredients/recipes/allergens: deterministic handoff
changes: Prompt rule 13 (default rules): 'INGREDIENTES, ELABORACIÓN, CALDOS, ALÉRGENOS E INTOLERANCIAS: no dispones de esta información salvo que una herramienta la devuelva literalmente. NUNCA supongas ni digas "generalmente"/"normalmente". Indica que eres un asistente de IA y que por seguridad alimentaria debe confirmarlo el restaurante, y envía send_contact con esa explicación. Ofrece anotar la intolerancia en los comentarios de la reserva.'

Deterministic pre-LLM guard (same shape as botExtrasIntentGuard): normalizeBotIntentText + regex for {alerg*, intoleran*, celiac*, gluten, lactosa, proteina de (la )?(vaca|leche), caldo, ingrediente*, lleva*, elabora*, vegano, vegetariano}. On match, send a fixed notice text and the management contact card (botSendContactCardWith with ManagementPhone), record both, return true. Coordination id: wa_bot_allergen_handoff_v1.
Keep 'add allergy note to booking' possible afterwards: the guard notice ends with '¿Quiere que anote la intolerancia en su reserva?', and the next customer turn goes to the LLM as usual.
Future (out of scope): expose dish allergens from comida/allergens_json through a get_dish_allergens tool. Only then may the bot answer allergen questions, and only from tool data.
plan.acceptance: Message 'El arroz seco de secreto con ajetes lo hacéis con caldo de ternera? ... intolerancia a la proteína de la vaca' produces notice text + contact card and no ingredient claims

plan.title: Enforce rule 1 (send_message) consistently
changes: Keep the agent_plain_text safety net but log a checkpoint '[bot] plain_text_fallback restaurant=%d sender=%s' so prompt drift is observable.
When a turn ends with plain text AND already sent a contact card, send the text first (see step 4). Never drop it.

plan.title: Verification on dev (manual, per CLAUDE.md: no automated tests)
checks: Deploy to newvillacarmen-backend-dev and send a 👍 reaction to a bot message: no reply, no SQLite row.
Type a message manually from the restaurant phone, then write as the customer: no bot reply until bot_paused_until expires; inbound rows are stored with source inbound_paused.
Send a bot-originated message: its FromMe echo must NOT pause the bot.
Ask an allergen/ingredient question: notice text + contact card, no invented recipe.
Ask to talk to a person: intro text + contact card (never a bare card).

Inspect SQLite: docker cp newvillacarmen-backend-dev:/var/lib/herorestaurant/. /tmp/devbotdb && sqlite3 ... "select id,role,source,content from conversation_messages where user_phone='<test>' order by id"
